title: Establishing redox flow batteries with polyoxometalate-based redox couples for enhanced hydrogen sulfide splitting
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,3278-3282
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00449G, Paper
Zihang Yu, Weiguang Ma, Enqing Xue, Yuening Ma, Yichen Zhang, Haofu Yuan, Yupeng Xiao, Hefeng Zhang, Xu Zong
We developed an innovative redox flow battery with polyoxometalate-based redox couples. This system successfully improved the efficient conversion of H2S into hydrogen and elemental sulfur.
